title: Black Canyon Ultras 2026 — ITRA results (100K and 50K)
claims: In the 2026 Black Canyon 100K, Hans Troyer finished first in 7:20:00, Anthony Costales second in 7:24:32 and Tracen Knopp third in 7:26:45, with 765 finishers listed.
The 2026 100K women's leaders were Jennifer Lichter in 7:57:05, Anne Flower in 7:57:59 and Tara Dower in 8:11:46.
In the 2026 Black Canyon 50K, Seth Ruhling finished first in 3:16:29, Adam Peterman second in 3:18:18 and Cade Michael third in 3:18:43, with 849 finishers listed.
The 2026 50K women's leaders were Jane Maus in 3:47:04, Liz O'Connor in 3:52:30 and Lindsay Allison in 3:55:44.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 读取 ITRA 2026 届 100K（110869）与 50K（110870）结果页，取总排名与女子前列。ITRA 结果页为第三方录入，作为 B 层引用。
